name: platinum-hair-lazy-fashion
image_vibe: Relaxed intimate denim editorial with platinum hair, warm beige minimalism, and natural softness
image_purpose: Create an editorial denim campaign portrait with an effortless beauty mood.

prompt.project_info: A close-up horizontal denim editorial portrait of an original adult woman reclining on a warm beige studio floor.
prompt.main_subject: An original adult woman with long platinum-white wavy hair spread across the floor, light natural freckles, fair skin, light green-gray eyes, nude-pink lips, and a soft neutral direct gaze. She wears an oversized dark indigo denim jacket with a classic western cut, button front, chest pockets, and a relaxed open drape over the shoulders.
prompt.composition_elements: Eye-level camera close to the floor, intimate close-up horizontal 4:3 framing of face and upper body, subject lying on her right side with her head near the floor turned toward the camera, hair spread across the beige surface, and a clean seamless studio background.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused warm studio lighting with even illumination and minimal shadows, clean professional environment, relaxed natural beauty mood, warm beige and dark indigo color contrast.
prompt.technical_specs: Professional studio photography, 85mm lens, f/4, 4:3 horizontal composition, realistic freckles, pores, hair strands, and denim weave, subtle film grain, natural optical falloff, high-resolution editorial detail, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic close-up horizontal 4:3 denim editorial portrait of an original adult woman lying on her right side on a warm beige studio floor. Give her long platinum-white wavy hair spread across the floor, fair natural skin with light freckles, light green-gray eyes, nude-pink lips, minimal makeup, and a soft neutral direct gaze. Dress her in an oversized dark indigo denim jacket with a classic western cut, button front, chest pockets, and a relaxed open drape over the shoulders. Keep her head near the floor turned toward camera and frame the face and upper body at eye level from close to the floor. Use soft diffused warm studio light, even illumination, minimal shadows, realistic hair, freckles, skin, and denim texture, an 85mm lens at f/4, subtle film grain, natural optical falloff, high-fashion denim campaign polish, and no text or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, minor or teen-coded subject, sexualized pose, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, messy background, watermark, text

assets.name: source platinum denim reclining portrait
assets.usage: Use only as optional guidance for platinum hair, indigo denim, reclining floor pose, warm beige seamless setting, and relaxed beauty mood; do not copy identity.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Preserve the original adult denim subject, platinum hair spread on the floor, open indigo jacket, right-side reclining pose, warm beige studio, direct gaze, and intimate editorial framing. Identity may vary.
